species.name: Aasimar
species.description: Mortals with a spark of the Upper Planes; celestial features, resistances, and special revelations.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.description: Dragon-like humanoids with draconic ancestry, breath weapon, and damage resistance.

species.name: Dwarf
species.description: Sturdy, long-lived folk with affinity for stone and metal. Dwarven resilience and stonecunning.

species.name: Elf
species.description: Graceful, long-lived beings connected to the Feywild with keen senses and trance.

species.name: Gnome
species.description: Small, clever tinkerers with gnomish cunning and lineage choices.

species.name: Goliath
species.description: Descendants of giants with supernatural boons and powerful build.

species.name: Halfling
species.description: Small, lucky folk known for nimbleness and bravery.

species.name: Human
species.description: Adaptable and diverse, humans gain flexible bonuses and inspiration.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Hardy, determined wanderers with adrenaline-driven abilities and endurance.

species.name: Tiefling
species.description: Mortals with fiendish ancestry, fiendish legacies, and darkvision.
